boards.title: Overview
boards.lead: The happy path from Check Rate to the Booking Summary, a frame per step. Each page's states are on its own board.

lanes.title: Happy path, end to end
lanes.story: Check Rate, Select Rate, then the plan (Eligibility Check, Personal Information, Packages), Confirm application, the Booking Summary.

boards.title: Check Rate
boards.lead: Where an order starts: where from, where to, and roughly how heavy. Then one rate, with the others on request.

lanes.title: Rate Check
lanes.story: As a visitor, I want to enter where I am moving from and to, plus a rough weight, so that I get a price without filling in a long form first.

lists.title: To confirm
items: Data dummy: tarif Special Rate dari tabel impor yang ada, normal rate FedEx/UPS dibuat-buat dan selalu lebih mahal per kg dari Special Rate. Berat dibulatkan ke atas ke kg utuh (aturan dummy, dev menentukan aturan aslinya). Saran alamat juga dummy, pengganti Google Places di live: alamat tanpa kode pos ditolak seperti di live.

gap.title: No rate available / country not served
gap.note: Asked by RPW-290: a clear message and a next action. Not in the prototype (its rates are local, so there's always one); listed under “Still to build”.

lanes.title: Rate Population
lanes.story: As a customer, I want one recommended price rather than a wall of options, so that I can decide quickly without comparing everything.

lists.title: Departs from the brief
items: Brief: “final price confirmed at quotation”. Prototype: the Quotation is still an estimate; the final price comes on the Invoice (the team's correction).

boards.title: Plan
boards.lead: The Eligibility Check, Personal Information and the Packages: three parts on one page, one open at a time, with one action.

lanes.title: Shell and stepper
lanes.story: As a customer partway through booking, I want to see which step I am on and move back without losing anything, so that a long form does not feel risky.

lists.title: Departs from the brief
items: Brief: a five-step indicator with back and next. Prototype: no stepper; the plan is one page, and a finished part folds and reopens from “Edit”.
Brief: Shipment Information, then Personal Information. Prototype: Your details first, the Packages last.
No footer anywhere in the flow (the team's call).

lanes.title: Customs Education Modal
lanes.story: As a customer, I want to understand the clearance paths and what each needs, so that I know whether to expect duty, and which documents to gather.

lists.title: Departs from the brief
items: Brief: two paths (Moving Goods, Personal Shipment). Prototype: three Customs Paths, with Passenger Goods (decided with the PM).
Brief closes with “Which path applies is confirmed by the Rimkirim team.” Prototype: the team recommends a path at review and the customer decides (ADR 0002).

lanes.title: Eligibility Check
lanes.story: As a business, I want the eligibility answers to decide which customs path a booking takes, so that ops can process it correctly without the customer needing to understand Indonesian customs.

lists.title: Departs from the brief
items: Brief: six options in Q1. Prototype: five; “Fine Art & High-Value Items” was dropped on 2026-11-20.
Brief: Q2 “In Indonesia” asks the length of stay. Prototype: a date in both branches (the PM's rule v1).
Under Q1 there's a “Cannot be shipped” block: information, not a question, and it doesn't stop the order.

Brief: four questions, the third a visa (then a VITAS and an ITAS), the fourth the reason for relocating. Prototype: five, the PM's revision (2026-11-24): the reason is third, the fourth asks for an ITAS for work or study valid 12 months or more, and a fifth asks whether the goods ship from the country they've been living in.

lists.title: To confirm
items: Pertanyaan Q3 sampai Q5 mengikuti revisi PM yang sudah dibangun dev di staging (disusul di prototipe 24 Nov 2026): Q3 alasan pindah (Work, Study, Something else), Q4 ITAS kerja atau belajar yang berlaku 12 bulan atau lebih (Yes, No or not yet) menggantikan pertanyaan visa beserta VITAS dan ITAS, dan Q5 apakah barang dikirim dari negara tempat customer tinggal selama ini. Flag Customs Category (internal, tidak tampil ke customer) dari tabel dummy: 1) alasan Something else → personal_shipment; 2) Work/Study tanpa ITAS 12 bulan (No or not yet) → needs_review; 3) barang tidak dikirim dari negara tempat tinggal (Q5 No) → needs_review; 4) sudah di Indonesia → needs_review; 5) sisanya → eligible_pindahan. Baris 2 dan 3 asumsi prototipe untuk menggantikan aturan visa; aturan yang jalan di staging milik dev. Q1, tanggal kedatangan, dan lama tinggal tidak mengubah flag. Perlu konfirmasi ops.

lanes.title: Furniture warning
lanes.story: As a customer who owns furniture or large items, I want a clear warning as soon as I declare them, so that I am not refused at collection because I assumed Rimkirim would pack them.

lists.title: Departs from the brief
items: Brief: a callout with exact copy (“Please note: Rimkirim does not provide a packing service for furniture or large items…”) that appears when furniture is selected and goes when it's deselected. Prototype: the note “You pack everything yourself” always shows; furniture only adds “, furniture included”.
Brief: the same warning again in Shipment Information. Prototype: not there yet.

gap.title: Furniture warning in Shipment Information
gap.note: Asked by the brief: the same callout again when furniture is declared in a package. In the prototype, choosing the “Furniture” category shows nothing.
gap.via: Choose the “Furniture” category in a package

lanes.title: Personal Information
lanes.story: As a customer, I want to enter my details and when I am moving, so that Rimkirim can arrange pickup and reach me about the shipment.

lists.title: Departs from the brief
items: Brief: a Detail Address required on both sides, with a map pin. Prototype: optional, no pin (the team's call).

Brief: one relocation date, its first two days closed. Prototype (the PM's revision, RPW-293, 2026-11-23): when to collect is asked first. Within 3 months a date is required, from tomorrow to day 90; more than 3 months, the date is optional. Weekends stay closed.
Brief: “Confirm Application” is enabled only when everything is valid. Prototype: the button is never disabled, and shows what's missing.

lists.title: To confirm
items: Detail address bukan field di form: tiap alamat (asal dan tujuan) adalah kartu dengan tombol Change yang membuka editor di halaman yang sama (alamat dan detail). Kedua detail opsional atas permintaan tim (epic menandainya wajib): kartu tanpa detail menawarkan tombol Add detail address, dan form tetap bisa dilanjutkan tanpanya. Pin di peta dihapus atas permintaan tim (epic memintanya). Mengganti alamat di sini tidak mengubah tarif (dummy: tarif hanya dari negara asal dan berat); kalau tarif asli memakai kode pos, ganti alamat harus menghitung ulang. Semua field lain wajib (epic hanya menandai detail address), karena email dan nomor telepon dibutuhkan untuk konfirmasi dan follow-up. Tanggal pickup bisa dipilih mulai besok (H+1), hari kerja saja; epic menyebut H+3, diubah sesuai feedback tim. Sejak 23 Nov 2026 (PM, RPW-293) form dulu menanyakan kapan dijemput: Within 3 months (besok sampai hari ke-90, tanggal wajib) atau More than 3 months (mulai hari ke-91, tanggal opsional); hari order dan akhir pekan tidak bisa dipilih, dan mengganti jawaban mengosongkan tanggal yang di luar rentangnya. Label field-nya "Pickup date", bukan "When are you planning to relocate" seperti di epic, atas permintaan tim.

lanes.title: Shipment Information (Packages)
lanes.story: As a customer, I want to list every package with its size, weight and contents, so that my quote and customs paperwork match what I am actually sending.

lists.title: Departs from the brief
items: Brief: each package's length, width, height and weight. Prototype: pick the closest size (Small, Medium or Large Box) or Custom; only Custom is measured (the team's revision, 2026-11-20).
Brief: a description and a value per item. Prototype: a row per category, with its quantity and its value in total.
Brief: an empty state with “Add package”. Prototype: it starts with Package 1.

lists.title: To confirm
items: Langkah baru di luar epic, atas permintaan tim, sebagai bagian terakhir plan, setelah Your details: Packages (dulu Packing List; diganti karena packing list adalah dokumen bea cukai, Commercial Invoice/Packing List) dengan field yang sama seperti modul Barang & Paket di flow WNI (kemasan, berat, panjang/lebar/tinggi, isi tiap paket dengan jumlah dan nilai, mata uang), tanpa foto ukuran: fitur foto dan peringatan konfirmasi tanpa foto milik WNI dihapus atas permintaan tim. Kemasan Others membuka field teks bebas "What's it packed in?" dengan contoh di placeholder dan di bawah field (tas golf, hard case, tas ski, trunk, case alat musik). Yang wajib: berat, tiga sisi, nama barang, jumlah, dan isian kemasan Others kalau dipilih; nilai barang opsional. Setelah semua paket terukur, estimasi di Selected Service dihitung ulang untuk layanan yang sama dengan berat chargeable paket (dummy, rumus volumetrik /5000 seperti WNI); kalau layanan itu tidak tersedia di berat tersebut (Special Rate di bawah tier pertama), estimasi Check Rate dipertahankan. Perlu konfirmasi: (1) jumlah wajib dan nilai opsional; (2) estimasi memang mengikuti berat paket; (3) catatan biaya handling untuk kemasan selain kardus; (4) ambang peringatan salah satuan (sisi di atas 300 cm, paket di atas 500 kg) masih angka sementara, perlu batas asli dari carrier. Info pemeriksaan fisik (paket bisa dibuka, 18 Nov 2026; diperbarui 20 Nov 2026 dari brief ops 'Pemeriksaan Fisik Barang Impor': catatan di Packages kini judul plus 'bukan berarti ada masalah' dan 'daftar yang jelas dan sesuai membuatnya lebih kecil kemungkinannya', dan baris di Booking Summary menyebut tambahan waktu dan biaya gudang serta balasan dalam 5 hari kerja untuk pertanyaan Bea Cukai yang kami teruskan); link 'How inspections work' mengarah ke jawaban FAQ landing (#faq-inspection) sampai ada halaman sendiri. Revisi 20 Nov 2026 (keputusan Hira): judul form kini 'Estimate your shipment', dengan lead dan baris 'Not packed yet?' dari Andita (marketing communication). Tiap paket pertama memilih ukuran kardus: Box A (32 × 23 × 30 cm), Box B (43 × 37 × 37 cm), Box C (55 × 54 × 40 cm), atau Other. Box adalah patokan ukuran, customer tetap memakai kardusnya sendiri. Box standar tidak ditanya berat maupun ukuran: estimasinya memakai berat volumetrik box (sekitar 4,4 / 11,8 / 23,8 kg), dan invoice memakai berat aktual kalau ternyata lebih berat. Hanya Other yang ditanya kemasan, berat, dan tiga sisi (peringatan salah satuan juga hanya di Other). Isi paket kini satu baris per kategori (dropdown yang bisa dicari, dengan contoh barang; Others membuka isian 'What is it?'), jumlah, dan nilai total baris itu; kategori yang sama tidak bisa dipilih dua kali dalam satu paket. Di booking, nilai disimpan per barang (total ÷ jumlah) supaya bentuk datanya sama dengan flow WNI. Draft lama tetap aman: paket yang sudah diukur jadi Other, barang jadi Others dengan namanya, nilai per barang dikali jumlah. Perlu konfirmasi: (1) ukuran dalam Box A/B/C (dibaca dari foto, label Box A sebagian tertutup lakban); (2) [selesai, revisi kedua 20 Nov 2026: field kini 'Package size', tile Other kini 'Custom', dan semua paket ditanya 'Estimated weight' setelah ukurannya dipilih, jadi estimasi memakai yang lebih besar antara berat perkiraan dan berat volumetrik; Custom hanya ditanya kemasan dan tiga sisi; ketiga ukuran kini dinamai Small Box, Medium Box, Large Box (Kardus Kecil, Sedang, Besar), Box A/B/C tetap di data]; (3) 16 kategori masih sementara, akan diganti kategori dari tim dev berbasis HS code; (4) apakah ops atau Bea Cukai masih butuh deskripsi barang per baris untuk commercial invoice/packing list, selain kategori.

lanes.title: Change service
lanes.story: Not in the brief: the service can be changed on the plan without going back to Check Rate, and every answer stays.

lists.title: To confirm
items: Di luar epic, atas permintaan tim: layanan bisa diganti dari kartu Selected service tanpa kembali ke Check Rate. Daftarnya sama dengan Check Rate (data dummy), tapi semua tarif langsung tampil (di Check Rate, epic meminta satu tarif dan sisanya di balik "See more rates"), dihitung pada berat yang sedang dipakai estimasi: berat paket kalau semua paket sudah terukur, kalau belum berat Check Rate. Special Rate yang baru berlaku di berat paket ikut ditawarkan. Negara asal dan berat tetap diganti di Check Rate. Perlu konfirmasi ops: apakah tarif asli boleh dihitung ulang pada berat paket saat layanan diganti.

boards.title: Booking Summary
boards.lead: What the customer sees after Confirm application: proof the booking landed, and what happens next.

lanes.title: Booking submit and summary
lanes.story: As a customer who just submitted, I want immediate confirmation and a record of what I booked, so that I know it worked and what happens next.

lists.title: Departs from the brief
items: Not in the brief: the dialog “We'll contact you within 1 working day” on arriving (the team's request, 2026-11-23).
What happens next stops at pickup; the Invoice comes once the belongings reach Rimkirim's warehouse (the team's correction).

lists.title: To confirm
items: Tidak ada backend: tiket tersimpan di localStorage dan tampil di /simulator (tab Pesanan expat) bersama flag dan seluruh jawaban eligibility. Email Booking Summary hanya pratinjau di simulator, dikirim sama ke customer dan hello@rimkirim.com, tanpa flag. Info pemeriksaan fisik (paket bisa dibuka, 18 Nov 2026; diperbarui 20 Nov 2026 dari brief ops 'Pemeriksaan Fisik Barang Impor': catatan di Packages kini judul plus 'bukan berarti ada masalah' dan 'daftar yang jelas dan sesuai membuatnya lebih kecil kemungkinannya', dan baris di Booking Summary menyebut tambahan waktu dan biaya gudang serta balasan dalam 5 hari kerja untuk pertanyaan Bea Cukai yang kami teruskan); link 'How inspections work' mengarah ke jawaban FAQ landing (#faq-inspection) sampai ada halaman sendiri. Dialog 'We'll contact you within 1 working day' (23 Nov 2026, permintaan tim) muncul sekali setelah Confirm application, tidak saat reload: tim customer experience menghubungi lewat WhatsApp dan email, dalam 1 hari kerja dan sebelum quotation, untuk dokumen bea cukai (Document Compliance) dan packing list (Create Packing List); langkah 1 What happens next dan email-nya menyebut hal yang sama.

boards.title: Internal ticket
boards.lead: What reaches the team after Confirm application: a ticket with the answers, the packages, the contact and the Customs Category, and the confirmation email.

lanes.title: Handover to ops
lanes.story: Everything reaches the internal ticket: eligibility answers, packages and contact details are carried to ops, including the internal customs flag the customer never sees.

lists.title: Departs from the brief
items: The Customs Category here follows the team's dummy rule (five rules, docs/expat-order-flow.md), waiting for ops to confirm.
The ticket and the email are stand-ins: the ticket is kept on the device, the email is only previewed.

boards.title: Landing
boards.lead: The Expat Relocation landing, a lane per story. Each frame is a whole section, from its heading to its end; the hero is one screen.

lanes.title: Hero
lanes.story: As a relocating expat landing on the page, I want to grasp in seconds that Rimkirim ships my belongings to Indonesia, and where to start, so that I can get a quote without hunting around the page.

lists.title: Departs from the brief
items: Brief: the CTA reads “Get a quote”. Prototype: “Check your rate”, since the figure is an Estimate, not a quote (CONTEXT.md).

lists.title: To confirm
items: Pastikan klaim 'by air', pickup dari pintu, dan antar sampai pintu berlaku untuk semua negara asal expat. Papan keberangkatan di eyebrow menampilkan negara asal GBR, NLD, DEU, AUS, USA, FRA, JPN, SGP: konfirmasi daftarnya (RouteBoard.tsx). Foto hero adalah kiriman asli: pastikan ada izin customer. Label FedEx (nama, alamat, nomor AWB) dan nama yang ditulis di kardus sudah disensor mosaik. Notifikasi WhatsApp di pojok foto adalah contoh ('Your boxes have cleared customs in Indonesia. Next stop: your door.'), bukan tentang kiriman di foto: konfirmasi tim memang mengabarkan clearance lewat WhatsApp.

Semua 'Check your rate' mengarah ke order flow di situs ini (/expat-relocation/rates): Check Rate, Eligibility Check, data diri, lalu Booking Summary dan email. Data harga, alamat, peta, dan pengiriman email masih dummy; lihat docs/expat-order-flow.md. Semua link WhatsApp sudah ke nomor live (+62 817 1717 7008).

lanes.title: Testimonials
lanes.story: As a cautious first-time shipper, I want to see real customers who already moved their belongings, so that I trust Rimkirim with things I cannot replace.

lists.title: To confirm
items: Tiga ulasan, tanpa foto (2026-11-16). Ulasan Leticia Marina Bevilaqua (Inggris Raya ke Indonesia) adalah ulasan expat asli, ditampilkan utuh atas permintaannya dan dipotong dengan tombol 'Read more'. Dua lainnya diambil verbatim dari Google Review Rimkirim: daelyn (Bristol ke Jakarta) dan Phoebe Abigaille (Sydney ke Jakarta). Belum ada expat yang mengulas Rimkirim di Google, jadi keduanya WNI yang pulang, dan copy-nya tidak pernah menyebut mereka expat. Rating di bawah judul adalah rating Google Rimkirim secara keseluruhan (4.9), dengan link ke Google. Kalau ada ulasan expat baru di Google atau lewat WhatsApp (dengan izin), ganti daelyn atau Phoebe di EXPAT_REVIEWS (lib/data/expat.ts).

lanes.title: What you can ship
lanes.story: As a visitor deciding whether Rimkirim fits, I want to see clearly what is allowed and what is not, so that I do not start a booking that will be refused later.

lists.title: Departs from the brief
items: Brief: the cannot-ship list is provisional. Prototype: today's “Not allowed” list (alcohol, cigarettes and vapes, weapons, flammables, cash, jewellery, plants, motor vehicles).

lists.title: To confirm
items: DRAFT dari update ops (6 Nov 2026), diselaraskan dengan dokumen ops 'Ringkasan Product Import Rimkirim' sebagai source of truth. Susunannya: (A) lima tile barang yang paling sering dikirim, disusun sebagai bento (Pakaian dua kolom sebagai hero), tiap tile bisa dibuka (kartu Sepeda dihapus atas feedback Alvin, 10 Nov 2026: kemungkinan besar sepeda tidak bisa dikirim; sepeda juga dihapus dari FAQ, panduan pengemasan, dan tabel tarif); (B) 'How to pack your belongings', panduan pengemasan yang dituju link di order flow (#packing): customer mengemas semua barangnya sendiri, termasuk furnitur, lalu koper & tas, kardus, kemasan khusus di bawah aturan harga per koli, satu baris soal klaim, lalu panduan mengemas furnitur langkah demi langkah (bagian 10 dokumen ops); (C) 'Before you send': yang perlu konfirmasi dulu di samping yang tidak boleh dikirim. Dari dokumen ops: kartu Pakaian sekarang menyebut pakaian bekas curah (HS 6309) dilarang, jadi pakaian dikemas dilipat, jumlah wajar, dan dicatat per kardus; buku bea masuk 0% dan tanpa PPh untuk semua buku lewat barang kiriman, bukan hanya buku ilmu pengetahuan (revisi Alvin, 10 Nov 2026: buku cetak, dan PPN mungkin tetap berlaku tergantung jenis bukunya); furnitur bisa dikirim kalau 3PL punya layanannya dan customer mengemas sendiri. Yang perlu dikonfirmasi: (1) dua angka [X] dari dokumen ops sebelumnya masih diisi dari tabel surcharge: sisi terpanjang 121 cm dan 25 kg per kardus (di engine, 25 kg ambang biaya overweight, bukan batas); (2) dikonfirmasi tim (9 Nov 2026): tidak ada repack di gudang, semua barang dikemas customer, dan barang yang kemasannya tidak sesuai panduan tidak ditolak saat pickup, tapi kalau rusak tidak bisa diklaim sesuai nilai yang dideklarasikan. Panduan pengemasan Rimkirim dibuat dari packing guidelines FedEx: isi koper, kardus, dan kemasan khusus belum dicocokkan dengan dokumen itu; (3) biaya tambahan furnitur ('menyusul' di dokumen ops) belum ditampilkan; (4) tombol 'Cek Harga' mengarah ke kalkulator relocation (EXPAT_QUOTE_URL); (5) daftar 'Not allowed' (alkohol, rokok & vape, senjata & bahan peledak, barang mudah terbakar, uang tunai, perhiasan, tanaman, dan kendaraan bermotor; kendaraan bermotor ditambahkan 16 Nov 2026 dari eligibility rule v1 PM, sama dengan info 'Cannot be shipped' di order flow) belum ada di dokumen mana pun: dokumen import hanya menyebut Barang Dilarang Impor (Permendag 47/2025, termasuk HS 6309), barang kena cukai yang tidak bebas bea, dan 11 jenis barang di Pasal 42 ayat (8) yang belum dirinci. Pastikan daftar ini, mungkin dari aturan carrier. Gambar di tiap tile adalah ilustrasi contoh (barang digambar sebagai SVG: baju terlipat, sneakers dan topi; tiga buku dengan pita lime; lampu, mangkuk dan panci; gitar akustik, raket, kok dan bola golf, tanpa garis ukuran; piringan hitam dan sampulnya), bukan foto kiriman asli: isi paket di tile Pakaian (Winter coats 3, Jeans 5, Trainers 2) dan pertanyaan di tile Barang lainnya (teleskop, piringan hitam, mesin kopi, mesin jahit) bukan data ops; mesin kopi dan mesin jahit memang elektronik yang perlu dicek dulu, sesuai pesan tile itu. Angka 0% di tile Buku dibaca langsung dari tabel tarif bea cukai, jadi keduanya selalu sama.

lanes.title: Who does what
lanes.story: As a customer, I want to see exactly which parts Rimkirim handles and which are mine, so that nothing surprises me on pickup day.

lists.title: To confirm
items: Konfirmasi pembagian tugas. Revisi copy (12 Nov 2026): deskripsi di bawah tiap poin dihapus, jadi tiap poin kini satu baris yang berdiri sendiri, dan lima judul dipertajam supaya infonya tidak hilang: 'Customs paperwork, filed on your behalf', 'Customs clearance, export and import', 'Pack everything yourself, furniture included', 'Send the documents we ask for', 'Be there on pickup day, or have someone there'. Dokumen tidak lagi dirinci di sini: tim mereview pesanan dulu, merekomendasikan jalur bea cukai, baru meminta dokumennya; rincian tiap jalur ada di section customs dan FAQ, mengikuti dokumen ops 'Ringkasan Product Import Rimkirim'. Foto pickup adalah kiriman customer asli: pastikan ada izin customer. Wajah kurir, plat nomor, dan label AWB sudah disensor mosaik. Ilustrasi chat WhatsApp di iPhone (di samping daftar) adalah contoh, mengikuti order flow baru: tim sudah mereview packing list, meminta wine dikeluarkan dan memberi tahu HP baru kemungkinan kena pajak, lalu mengonfirmasi pickup di tanggal yang dipilih customer saat order, dengan rentang jam. Konfirmasi alurnya. Revisi 20 Nov 2026 (Kevin): poin 'One team on WhatsApp' kini 'One team on WhatsApp and email', sejalan dengan baris Tracking dan Support di Why Rimkirim; percakapan contoh di ilustrasinya tetap WhatsApp.

lanes.title: Why Rimkirim
lanes.story: As a customer comparing shipping options, I want to see what makes Rimkirim different for Indonesia specifically, so that I can choose without reading three competitor sites.

lists.title: To confirm
items: Usulan agency (04b), copy menunggu verifikasi ops: terutama 'estimasi dengan rincian biaya sebelum memesan', 'kabar status di setiap tahap, termasuk clearance', dan pendampingan personal. Kompetitor tidak disebut, dan packing sengaja tidak dibandingkan (dibahas di How it works). Kolom 'opsi umum' diriset dari halaman publik jasa kirim bagasi dan perusahaan pindahan internasional (2026-10-29). Klaim Rimkirim yang perlu dikonfirmasi: antar sampai pintu di semua kota tujuan (termasuk kota yang belum terlayani domestik seperti Makassar), customer tidak perlu datang ke bea cukai, dan kabar status lewat WhatsApp di setiap tahap. Revisi 13 Nov 2026 (HP): di HP perbandingannya kini tabel dua kolom berdampingan; kolom opsi umum dapat headline pendek sendiri yang dirangkum dari kalimat risetnya (mis. 'Fees often billed on arrival', 'Import clearance often yours', 'Often ends at a port or warehouse'), jadi headline itu ikut perlu dicek; kalimat lengkap kedua sisi muncul saat aspeknya di-tap. Revisi 14 Nov 2026 (cek fakta): baris biaya tidak lagi menjanjikan 'harga sebelum memesan' (sebelum memesan hanya ada estimasi, quotation pun masih estimasi, dan bea serta pajak ditagih terpisah); pembedanya kini review sebelum pickup: barang yang kemungkinan kena pajak atau tidak bisa dikirim ditandai, dan Rimkirim memilihkan jalur bea cukai yang paling hemat dengan persetujuan customer. Dokumen tidak lagi dijanjikan 'lancar di clearance'. Opsi umum di baris pintu ke pintu tidak lagi menyebut pelabuhan atau bandara (tidak ada di riset). 'Sigap menjawab, meski beda zona waktu' diambil dari pujian customer untuk tim CX, mohon dikonfirmasi tim CX. Catatan kaki kini hanya menyebut urutannya (estimasi dari berat yang diisi, quotation dari paket yang didaftarkan, harga final di invoice); kalimat 'berdasarkan ukuranmu sendiri' dan soal menyanggah ukuran carrier dihapus dari semua copy (catatan kaki ini, FAQ harga, cek tarif, Selected Service, dan bagian harga) atas permintaan Hira, 16 Nov 2026. Revisi 20 Nov 2026 (Kevin): email ikut disebut di baris Tracking (headline dan kalimat: 'Every stage, on WhatsApp or email') dan Support (kalimat: 'on WhatsApp and email'), dari hipotesis Kevin bahwa WNA mungkin lebih suka email; 'One team on WhatsApp' di What we coordinate ikut jadi 'on WhatsApp and email'. Perlu dikonfirmasi ops: (1) kabar status tiap tahap, termasuk clearance, benar dikirim lewat email, dan dari inbox mana (TEAM_INBOX di kode: hello@rimkirim.com); (2) cara customer memilih WhatsApp atau email, karena order flow tidak menanyakannya (usul: ops menanyakannya saat review; field pilihan di flow adalah fitur baru di luar epic); (3) 'answers promptly' juga berlaku untuk email. Link 'Ask us on WhatsApp' sengaja belum diubah.

lanes.title: Pricing information
lanes.story: As a customer, I want to understand what actually shapes my price, so that the number does not feel arbitrary when I see it.

lists.title: Departs from the brief
items: Brief: “final price confirmed at quotation”. Prototype: the Quotation is still an estimate; the final price comes on the Invoice (the team's correction).

lists.title: To confirm
items: Ambang 25 kg dan 50 kg di ilustrasi diambil dari tabel FedEx di modal Surcharge Information (sama dengan engine surcharge). Modal Surcharge Information sama dengan di situs utama (FedEx/DHL/UPS + biaya logistik lain). Konfirmasi semuanya berlaku untuk rute expat, terutama surcharge packaging untuk koper yang kini disebut di copy dan ditandai di ilustrasi. Revisi (12 Nov 2026): section ini tidak lagi mendaftar faktor harga (Route, Weight, Dimension, Surcharges) tetapi menjelaskan cara hitungnya, urut: chargeable weight tiap barang, dijumlahkan, dikali tarif per kilo, ditambah surcharge penanganan kalau ada barang yang memerlukannya. Istilahnya disamakan dengan situs utama dan carrier: actual weight, volumetric weight, chargeable weight (bukan real, size, charged). Tiap langkah punya gambarnya sendiri, dan gambarnya bergerak (motion graphic), pakai satu contoh yang sama (revisi 13 Nov 2026): satu kiriman tiga barang, angkanya asli. Kardus 1 (8,4 kg, 50×40×38 cm, volumetrik 15,2 kg), koper dari sheet ops (20,97 kg), dan kardus buku (51,6 kg). Aturan pembulatan dari sheet ops: ROUNDUP(MAX(aktual, volumetrik), 0) per barang, baru dijumlahkan. Langkah 1 hanya Kardus 1: 15,2 kg dibulatkan ke atas jadi 16 kg; langkah 2 menjumlahkan 16 + 21 + 52 = 89 kg; langkah 3 memakai kartu tarif asli dari Check Rate tanpa angka rupiah (harganya garis kosong), berganti asal lalu layanan; langkah 4 adalah rincian surcharge di quotation untuk ketiga barang, dengan nama dari tabel FedEx di modal: Kardus 1 tidak kena, koper kena Suitcase/Bag, kardus buku kena Overweight (di atas 25 kg) dan Oversize (di atas 50 kg), lalu hanya Oversize yang ditagih dan Overweight dicoret. Di layar lebar keempatnya main estafet sekali (sekitar 10 detik) dengan tombol pause dan replay; di tablet dan HP tiap gambar main waktu masuk layar; klik gambar untuk mengulang langkahnya. Tanpa angka rupiah karena tarif masih dummy dan beda tiap negara, dan nominal surcharge tetap di modal sampai ops mengonfirmasinya. Geraknya perlu dilihat langsung: tempo tiap langkah masih angka awal. Yang perlu dikonfirmasi: surcharge memang belum termasuk estimasi Check Rate dan tercantum di quotation.

lanes.title: How it works
lanes.story: As a customer, I want a simple step-by-step of what happens from quote to delivery, so that I know what I am committing to before I start.

lists.title: Departs from the brief
items: Brief: two duty paths (moving goods, personal shipment). Prototype: three Customs Paths, in a section of their own after the steps.

lists.title: To confirm
items: Urutan langkah mengikuti order flow baru: melengkapi form (Check Rate bagian pertamanya, lalu lima pertanyaan, data diri dan paket), review packing list oleh tim lalu quotation (masih estimasi), pickup dan pengiriman, lalu antar. Revisi copy (11 Nov 2026): langkah 01 kini 'Complete the form', bukan 'Check your rate'; teks langkah 02 dan 03 diringkas, jadi cek dokumen, rekomendasi jalur bea cukai, instruksi label, dan harga final di invoice tidak lagi disebut di sini (masih ada di bagian harga, customs dan FAQ); tim mereview sendiri, bukan 'bersama' customer; kalimat clearance di langkah 03 memakai wording Alvin, sama dengan daftar 'We take care of'. Ilustrasi adalah contoh: langkah 01 memakai kartu rate asli dari flow (tarif dummy), langkah 02 contoh review packing list (wine dikeluarkan, HP baru kemungkinan kena pajak). Revisi copy Andita (20 Nov 2026): langkah 01 dan 02 kini memakai copy dari Andita (marcomm), menjawab feedback Kevin bahwa user perlu tahu cara tim mereview: packing list diperiksa satu per satu, lalu tim memberi tahu barang yang tidak bisa dikirim dan yang kemungkinan kena pajak impor, baru quotation dikirim. Revisi kedua (20 Nov 2026): teks langkah 02 kini juga menyebut tim menyarankan dokumen bea cukai yang perlu disiapkan (sesuai urutan: review, rekomendasi jalur bea cukai, baru minta dokumennya), dan 'exactly' di 'so you know exactly what to expect' dihapus.

Diselaraskan dengan dokumen ops 'Ringkasan Product Import Rimkirim' (source of truth): tiga jalur, yaitu barang pindahan (PMK 25/2025), barang penumpang yang dikirim terpisah (PMK 203/2017 jo. PMK 34/2025), dan barang kiriman pribadi (PMK 4/2025), plus tabel tarif barang kiriman jalur CN sampai USD 1.500 (bagian 7). Revisi Alvin (10 Nov 2026): kartu barang pindahan mengikuti narasinya (barang rumah tangga dalam jumlah wajar, tiba 90 hari sebelum atau sesudah kedatangan, commercial invoice/packing list dengan template dari kami, kendaraan dan barang kena cukai tidak termasuk); kalimat WNI yang pulang dengan surat pindah dihapus karena layanan ini untuk WNA; daftar dokumen kini 'Documents needed', dengan satu baris di bawah ketiga kartu bahwa bea cukai sesekali meminta dokumen tambahan; buku di tabel tarif kini 'buku cetak', tanpa PPh dan PPN mungkin berlaku. Revisi Alvin kedua (10 Nov 2026): kartu barang penumpang dan barang kiriman pribadi juga mengikuti narasinya. Penumpang: bebas bea dan pajak sampai USD 500, di atasnya BM 10% plus PPN atas kelebihannya, dokumen paspor, tanggal kedatangan dan detail penerbangan, serta commercial invoice/packing list. Kiriman pribadi (nama jalurnya kini 'Barang Kiriman Pribadi'): tanpa pembebasan, tarif flat 0% sampai 25% plus PPN, paspor atau NPWP, commercial invoice/packing list, harga kami hanya ongkos kirim, PPh lebih tinggi tanpa NPWP. Ketiga kartu kini memuat aturannya sendiri, jadi blok 'Good to know' dihapus: 90 hari dan pengecualian kendaraan serta barang kena cukai ada di kartu barang pindahan, larangan pakaian bekas curah ada di kartu Pakaian dan FAQ. Catatan di bawah tabel tarif tidak lagi mengulang kalimat NPWP dan 'bea cukai menetapkan bea final'. Revisi 13 Nov 2026: janji template commercial invoice/packing list dihapus dari kartu, order flow, dan FAQ. Dihapus karena tidak ada di dokumen: syarat 'barang terpakai', 'barang baru tidak bebas bea', kulkas/freezer/AC diblokir (dokumen: pindahan dan penumpang dikecualikan dari API/PI/LS lewat Permendag 16/2025 Pasal 42 ayat 4), dan tiket pesawat di daftar dokumen. Masih perlu dicek: (1) jendela waktu barang penumpang unaccompanied terhadap kedatangan (dokumen menandainya), jadi halaman hanya bilang 'diatur sesuai waktu kedatanganmu'; (2) apakah barang yang dibawa sendiri dan yang dikirim terpisah berbagi jatah USD 500; (3) PPN barang pindahan untuk WNA (dokumen: cakupan WNA perlu dicek), jadi halaman hanya menjanjikan bebas bea masuk, bukan bebas pajak; (4) tarif PPh tanpa NPWP (kartu hanya bilang 'lebih tinggi'); (5) 'sekitar 22% dari kelebihan' dihitung dari BM 10% + PPN 11% atas (kelebihan + BM), cocok dengan contoh USD 800 di dokumen; (6) template commercial invoice/packing list: dokumen terpisah yang kami kirim, atau dibuat dari data paket yang customer isi di order flow (langkah Packages, kode RKPL)?; (7) 'ditagihkan terpisah': bea dan pajak ditagih Rimkirim di invoice, atau customer membayar langsung ke bea cukai? Jawaban Hira (23 Nov 2026) untuk nomor (6): customer membuat commercial invoice/packing list sendiri di halaman packing list Rimkirim (/packing-list/buat); nilainya harga barang saat ini, tanpa struk; namanya selalu ditulis lengkap, tidak pernah disingkat 'CIPL'. Barisnya tetap di dalam daftar tiap jalur, di kartu landing maupun di guide 'How your belongings clear customs' dan Booking Summary di order flow (sempat ditulis sekali di atas ketiga jalur, lalu dikembalikan ke dalam daftar atas permintaan Hira, 23 Nov 2026). Di guide order flow ada satu section tambahan setelah ketiga jalur, 'What's a commercial invoice/packing list?': penjelasan singkat (daftar barang per paket dengan nilainya; dibuat sendiri di halaman packing list Rimkirim) dan link 'Read more in the FAQ' ke #faq-invoice-packing-list (tab baru). Keterangan 'with each item's value' dihapus dari baris dokumen di kartu dan dari jawaban FAQ 'What documents will I need?': dokumennya sendiri sudah pasti memuat nilai tiap barang (Hira, 23 Nov 2026).

lanes.title: FAQs
lanes.story: As a customer with specific questions, I want answers to the common questions in one place, so that I do not have to open WhatsApp to learn the basics.

lists.title: To confirm
items: Brief: semua jawaban wajib disetujui Rimkirim, terutama bea cukai & pengantaran. Revisi 17 Nov 2026: 'How long' mengikuti infografis ETA dari tim OPS (sama dengan FAQ /faq): transit 4–8 hari, clearance 4–10 hari kerja, lalu pengantaran domestik per daerah dalam tabel, dijumlahkan; berlaku untuk kiriman dari Eropa, Australia dan Selandia Baru, Amerika, dan enam negara Asia, dan dari negara lain pembaca diarahkan ke Check Rate ('Check the ETA from your country'). Tabel diurutkan dari yang tercepat (urutan infografis berbeda), dan 'Jawa' di infografis berarti di luar Jabodetabek. 'By air' dan kalimat 'estimasi tampil saat cek tarif' dihapus: infografis tidak menyebut moda, dan Check Rate hanya menampilkan waktu transit. Draft 18 Nov 2026: 'Can my packages be opened?' ditulis dari info Hira, sebelum info lengkap OPS: yang membuka paket adalah 3PL atas rekomendasi Bea Cukai (biasanya setelah ada kejanggalan di X-ray) dan diawasi Bea Cukai; 3PL juga yang menutup kembali; Rimkirim tidak mendampingi pemeriksaan; kerusakan bisa diklaim selama memenuhi syarat klaim. Belum ada halaman lengkap, jadi link 'How inspections work' di order flow mengarah ke jawaban ini (#faq-inspection). Revisi 20 Nov 2026: draft itu diganti tiga pertanyaan dari brief ops 'Pemeriksaan Fisik Barang Impor' (berlaku untuk semua produk impor; sumber PMK 203/2017 Pasal 1 angka 8–9 dan 17–19, PMK 25/2025 Pasal 9–13, PMK 96/2023 Pasal 24–27, 31–32, 36, 40): (1) 'Can my packages be opened?': semua kiriman bisa diperiksa fisik, tidak bisa dihindari atau dijamin, dipilih per kiriman berdasarkan manajemen risiko dan sebagian acak, bukan berarti ada masalah, tidak menentukan bea dan pajak; (2) 'What makes an inspection more likely?': pemicu dari brief dan catatan lartas; (3) 'What happens if a package is inspected?': dibuka petugas kurir disaksikan Bea Cukai, permintaan informasi tambahan dijawab dalam 5 hari kerja, tiga kemungkinan hasil, tambahan waktu dan biaya gudang. Dari Hira (20 Nov 2026): kiriman expat selalu lewat kurir udara (FedEx, DHL, Aramex, dan lainnya), jadi jalur kargo dari brief tidak ditulis; permintaan informasi Bea Cukai diteruskan Rimkirim ke customer; biaya gudang tambahan ditagihkan ke customer; bea dan pajak kadang dibayar lewat Rimkirim, kadang langsung ke Bea Cukai, dan sengaja tidak dijelaskan. Tetap dari Hira (18 Nov): 3PL menutup kembali paketnya, kerusakan bisa diklaim. Masih kosong: link ke syarat klaim, dan halaman lengkap (brief ini cukup untuk satu halaman yang juga dipakai flow WNI). Revisi 23 Nov 2026 (Hira): pertanyaan baru 'What's a commercial invoice/packing list?' (#faq-invoice-packing-list) di bawah 'What documents will I need?': daftar barang per paket dengan jumlah dan nilainya, plus pengirim dan penerima (dari FAQ situs utama); nilai harga saat ini, tanpa struk; bukan tagihan; dibuat sendiri di halaman packing list Rimkirim, dengan link ke /packing-list/buat. Jawaban 'What documents will I need?' kini menyebut dokumen itu sekali untuk semua jalur.

lanes.title: Closing CTA
lanes.story: As a visitor who has read to the bottom, I want an obvious way to begin, so that I do not have to scroll back to the top to act.

lists.title: To confirm
items: Tiap langkah 'What happens next' menampilkan layar order flow yang asli, digambar oleh komponennya sendiri dengan data contoh: kartu Special Rate dari Inggris untuk 30 kg (tarif dummy), pertanyaan pertama Eligibility Check, dan kepala tiket Booking Summary dengan nomor dan email contoh.

rates-empty.title: Empty form
rates-empty.note: A first visit. The address is locked until the origin country is chosen.

rates-estimate.title: Estimate: Special Rate
rates-estimate.note: One rate, the cheapest. The origin country has a Special Rate, so that's the one shown first.

plan-start.title: Plan opens on the Eligibility Check
plan-start.note: Three parts on one page, one open. A part that can't be reached yet stands back.

plan-part-done.title: A part done, the next one open
plan-part-done.note: The Eligibility Check folds to a line that says the answers back; Your details opens under it.

pack-start.title: Package 1, not filled in
pack-start.note: The plan's last part. It starts with one package; its size is picked first, then its weight and what's inside.

plan-all-done.title: All three done
plan-all-done.via: Fill in Your details and the packages
plan-all-done.note: All folded, and the button reads “Confirm application”. Any part reopens from “Edit”.

plan-confirming.title: Confirming…
plan-confirming.note: Submitting: the plan stands still under a button that says what's happening.

booking-fresh.title: Just confirmed
booking-fresh.note: The “Booking received” head draws its check once, then the dialog “We'll contact you within 1 working day”.

booking-summary.title: Booking Summary
booking-summary.note: The booking number, What happens next (three steps, the invoice later), then the record of the order. The Customs Category never shows.

rates-address.title: Address suggestions
rates-address.via: Choose a country, type an address
rates-address.note: Typing in the address opens suggestions. A place without a postal code is listed too, but refused when it's picked.

rates-filled.title: Form filled in
rates-filled.via: Pick the addresses, enter the weight
rates-filled.note: Origin, destination and weight are in. The button is lime: there's something to check.

rates-checking.title: Checking…
rates-checking.note: Loading while the rate is fetched. The prototype's rates are local, so the wait is deliberate (pace.ts).

rates-required.title: Check rates with nothing filled in
rates-required.via: Press “Check rates” on an empty form
rates-required.note: Each missing field is marked where it is, and the first one takes focus.

rates-no-results.title: No address found
rates-no-results.via: Type an address that doesn't exist
rates-no-results.note: “No places found. Try a street name.”

rates-no-postal.title: A place without a postal code
rates-no-postal.note: Refused at once, not on Check rates: the rate is priced on the postal code.

rates-more.title: See more rates
rates-more.note: The other rates open under it, cheapest first.

rates-normal.title: Estimate: no Special Rate
rates-normal.via: A country without a Special Rate
rates-normal.note: Brazil has no Special Rate: the cheapest Normal Rate per kg is shown first.

rates-rounded.title: Weight rounded up
rates-rounded.note: 30.4 kg is priced as 31 kg: “Priced at 31 kg”.

rates-below-tier.title: Below the Special Rate's first tier
rates-below-tier.note: 10 kg isn't in the Special Rate yet (it starts at 21 kg): a Normal Rate is shown, with the weight the Special Rate starts at.

rates-stale.title: Form changed after the estimate
rates-stale.note: The old estimate dims and can't be selected until the rate is checked again.

plan-welcome.title: Back with a draft
plan-welcome.via: Close the tab, come back later
plan-welcome.note: The draft stays on the device until it's submitted. The next visit says so once: “Welcome back. Your answers are still here.”

plan-no-rate.title: Plan opened without a rate
plan-no-rate.via: Open /plan directly, before picking a rate
plan-no-rate.note: Sent back to Check Rate, with the reason: “Check your rate first, then plan your relocation.”

plan-missing.title: Continue with answers missing
plan-missing.note: The button is never disabled: what's missing is marked, the first of it takes focus, and a toast counts the rest.

customs-first.title: First visit: it opens itself
customs-first.via: Enter the plan for the first time
customs-first.note: Half a second after the plan appears, the guide comes out of its button. A dialog on desktop, a sheet on a phone.

customs-hint.title: Closed: the button says where it went
customs-hint.note: The guide goes back into its button, and that first time there are words beside it: “Open this again here, any time.”

customs-reopen.title: Opened again from its button
customs-reopen.note: On later visits the guide doesn't open itself; its button is always on screen.

elig-abroad.title: Not arrived yet, with an ITAS
elig-abroad.note: Q2 “Not yet” asks the estimated arrival date. Q4 asks for an ITAS for work or study, valid for 12 months or more; Q5 whether they ship from the country they've been living in.

elig-indonesia.title: Already in Indonesia, no ITAS yet
elig-indonesia.via: The other branch of Q2 and Q4
elig-indonesia.note: Q2 asks the day they arrived (up to today). Q4 “No or not yet” asks nothing more; the order goes on.

elig-others.title: “Others” in Q1, “Something else” in Q3
elig-others.note: Each asks for a few words. Q5 “No”: the goods ship from somewhere else. No answer stops the order.

elig-missing.title: Nothing answered
elig-missing.note: “Choose at least one.” on Q1, “Choose an answer.” on Q2 to Q5.

elig-followups.title: Follow-ups left empty
elig-followups.note: The arrival date and the “Others” and “Something else” texts are required once an answer brings them up.

elig-revised.title: A draft from before Q4 and Q5
elig-revised.via: Come back to answers saved before the change
elig-revised.note: Answers saved before the questions changed (2026-11-24) lose the visa ones and have none for Q4 and Q5. The check is open again, with those two to answer.

furn-off.title: Q1 without furniture
furn-off.via: Choose a category other than furniture
furn-off.note: The note “You pack everything yourself” is always under Q1, whatever is chosen.

furn-on.title: Q1 with furniture
furn-on.note: The note gains “, furniture included” and its link becomes “See how to pack furniture”.

details-address.title: An address card being changed
details-address.note: “Change” swaps the card for its editor in place: the Address (inside its country) and the Detail Address, which is optional.

details-date.title: Within 3 months: Pickup Date
details-date.note: There's no calendar until the question is answered. Within 3 months: weekdays from tomorrow to day 90, and a date is required. On a phone the calendar is a bottom sheet.

details-later.title: More than 3 months: the date is optional
details-later.note: The calendar starts on day 91, with no end. An empty date is a finished answer, not a mistake.

details-filled.title: Your details filled in
details-filled.note: Name, email, phone (the dial code from the origin country), when to collect and the Pickup Date; a Detail Address on both cards.

details-left.title: A field left while it's wrong
details-left.via: Type a wrong email, move on
details-left.note: The error shows once the field is left, not on the button: “Enter an email like name@domain.com.”

details-required.title: Continue with nothing filled in
details-required.note: “Required.” on each field, “Choose one to continue.” on when to collect, and a toast counts what's missing.

details-address-pick.title: Saving an address without picking one
details-address-pick.note: “Pick an address from the list, so we get its postal code.”

details-cleared.title: Answer changed, the date cleared
details-cleared.via: With a date picked, switch to “More than 3 months”
details-cleared.note: The two ranges never meet, so a date picked for the old answer is cleared, and that's said: “We cleared … because it's outside the dates this option allows.”

details-pickup-past.title: The Pickup Date has passed
details-pickup-past.via: Come back to an old draft
details-pickup-past.note: A draft from days ago: its date can't be used any more, and that's said at once.

details-changed.title: Address changed on Check Rate
details-changed.via: Change the destination Address on Check Rate
details-changed.note: That side's Detail Address is cleared, so the courier isn't sent to the old Address's unit; its card says so.

pack-category.title: Choosing what's inside
pack-category.note: Sixteen categories with examples, searchable. “Others” asks what it is.

pack-filled.title: Two packages filled in
pack-filled.via: Fill in size, weight and contents
pack-filled.note: One Medium Box, one Custom (a suitcase). The totals are under them, and the estimate now uses the packages' weight.

pack-missing.title: Confirm with a package unfinished
pack-missing.note: “Choose a package size.” and “Required.” where they apply; a folded package unfolds.

pack-category-empty.title: A category search with no match
pack-category-empty.via: Search for a category that isn't there
pack-category-empty.note: “Others” always stays in the list, so a search that matches nothing still has a way on: pick Others, then say what it is.

pack-odd.title: An unlikely size or weight
pack-odd.note: A side over 300 cm or a weight over 500 kg is asked about, never refused. Both numbers are still placeholders.

pack-remove.title: Removing a package
pack-remove.note: Asked first: its size, weight and contents go too, and it can't be undone.

pack-below-tier.title: Packages below the Special Rate's first tier
pack-below-tier.note: The packages' weight (5 kg) isn't in the Special Rate yet, so the estimate stays at the weight checked (30 kg).

plan-worst.title: Worst case
plan-worst.note: The longest value each field accepts: a 120-character name, an email that can't wrap, sizes typed in the wrong unit.

plan-many.title: 40 packages
plan-many.note: A whole house, package by package. The finished ones start folded.

service-change.title: Change your service
service-change.note: Every service for the route, the Special Rate first, then cheapest first. The one in use is marked “Selected”.

service-changed.title: Service changed
service-changed.via: Press “Select this rate” on another service
service-changed.note: The answers stay; the estimate is priced again, and a toast says which service is now in use.

booking-docs.title: Documents to get ready
booking-docs.note: The three Customs Paths with their documents, folded under the step that asks for them.

booking-later.title: Pickup more than 3 months away
booking-later.via: A booking with “More than 3 months” and no date
booking-later.note: No date: the pickup reads “To be confirmed, more than 3 months from now”, and step three says the date is agreed closer to the time.

plan-confirm-failed.title: Confirm fails
plan-confirm-failed.note: The error state RPW-294 asks for: nothing is registered, the draft is as it was, and a toast says to check the answers. Without a server, it's reached here through the data: an Address with no postal code.

booking-not-found.title: Booking not found
booking-not-found.via: Open a booking link on another device
booking-not-found.note: A booking exists only on the device that made it (mock). An unknown number is pointed to Check Rate.

booking-no-packages.title: A booking without packages
booking-no-packages.note: A booking made before the Packages were asked: that part is absent, the rest is whole.

booking-old-answers.title: A booking from before Q4 and Q5
booking-old-answers.note: Its visa answers are gone and it was never asked Q4 or Q5, so “Your answers” lists what it has: the arrival and the reason, no name with nothing beside it. The same on the internal ticket and in the email.

booking-many.title: 40 packages
booking-many.note: The first five show; the rest are behind “Show all 40 packages”.

booking-worst.title: Worst case
booking-worst.note: What the customer typed is shown as typed; an email or a long word may break anywhere.

ops-tickets.title: A ticket per Customs Category
ops-tickets.note: Three bookings, three flags: eligible_pindahan, needs_review, personal_shipment. The flag exists only here, never on the customer's side.

ops-email.title: Confirmation email preview
ops-email.note: The same email goes to the customer and to hello@rimkirim.com. In the prototype it can only be seen here.

ops-empty.title: No bookings yet
ops-empty.note: Before anything has been confirmed on this device.

land-hero.title: Hero
land-hero.note: The first screen: what is shipped, where to, and “Check your rate”.

land-reviews.title: Reviews
